title: Take over in place
subtitle: Tugra starts next to Coolify on a temporary port, every domain is checked, then the ports are handed over.

cert.fallback: Coolify's certificate, for a few minutes

giveBack.hint: Stops Tugra's proxy and starts Coolify's again.

rebuild.title: Rebuild with Tugra and verify
rebuild.hint: By default Tugra starts the image Coolify already built and nothing is built. Pick an app to build it with Tugra instead: the build must succeed and the app must answer like Coolify's copy before the ports are taken. Apps that share data with Coolify's copy cannot be rebuilt next to it.
rebuild.loading: Looking up which apps can be rebuilt…
rebuild.exclusive: {name} shares data with Coolify's copy, so it cannot be built next to it. It keeps Coolify's image.

none: No takeover yet for {server}. Planning only reads what Coolify runs on it; nothing is changed.

action.verify: Check again and get new certificates

hint.PLANNED: Read from the server. Nothing has been changed yet.
hint.TESTING: Tugra's proxy is up with no public port. Every domain is checked against what Coolify answers.
hint.SWAPPING: Handing the ports over. This takes a minute.
hint.SWAPPED: Tugra serves the sites now, with Coolify's certificate as a short fallback. Tugra checks every minute and gets a new certificate for each domain; you can also press check again.
hint.VERIFIED: Every domain works and has a new certificate. Coolify is still on the server until you remove it.
hint.GIVING_BACK: Putting Coolify back. This takes a minute.
hint.GIVEN_BACK: Coolify serves the sites again, as before.
hint.FAILED: The last step did not finish. Test again, or give the server back to Coolify.

rollup: {apps} apps ({skipped} left out), {domains} domains. Tested: {tested}. Checked after the switch: {checked}. New certificates: {issued}.
verifyAgain: Some domains still wait for a new certificate. Check again in a minute.

issue.container_absent: Coolify does not run this app right now, so there is nothing to take over.
issue.container_changed: Coolify's container changed while it was read. Plan again.
issue.volume_unmapped: This app writes to a volume Tugra's copy of the app does not declare. Add the volume to the app first.
issue.bind_unmapped: This app writes to a host folder Tugra's copy of the app does not mount. Add the mount to the app first.
issue.no_domain: This app has no domain to check.
issue.image_missing: The image Coolify built is no longer on the server.
issue.adopt_failed: The image could not be reused.
issue.volume_alias_failed: The data volume could not be shared with Tugra's copy.
issue.volume_alias_foreign: Tugra already has a different volume with that name.
issue.prepare_failed: Tugra's copy of the app did not start.
issue.db_image_differs: Tugra's copy of this database is set to another image than the one Coolify runs. Use the same image first.
issue.db_engine_unsupported: This database engine cannot be taken over in place.
issue.db_volume_unmapped: This database keeps data in a volume Tugra's copy of it does not declare. Add the volume to the database first.
issue.db_start_failed: Tugra's container for this database did not start on its data.
issue.db_verify_failed: This database did not look the same through Tugra.
issue.service_member_unmapped: Coolify runs a container for this service that Tugra's copy of the service has no part for. Add the part to the service first.
issue.service_member_absent: Tugra's copy of this service has a part Coolify runs no container for. A service is taken over whole or not at all.
issue.service_member_ambiguous: Coolify runs more than one container for a part of this service.
issue.service_image_differs: Tugra's copy of this service builds an image or sets it with a variable, so Coolify's image cannot be reused. Set a fixed image first.
issue.service_image_moved: The image tag of Tugra's copy now points at another image than the one Coolify's container runs. Plan again after pulling nothing, or pin the image.
issue.service_networks_unmapped: A network or name of this service cannot be carried to Tugra's copy (unsupported characters, or more than 8 networks or 4 names).
issue.service_compose_unsupported: Tugra's copy of this service is not a stored compose file Tugra can run in place (a compose from git, an adopted project or a cluster app).

failure.probe_unavailable: The server could not run the checks (curl is missing or the proxy is not up).
failure.exclusive_policy_failed: Coolify's restart policy could not be changed. Nothing was stopped.
failure.exclusive_stop_failed: A Coolify container would not stop. Everything was put back.
failure.exclusive_start_failed: Tugra's copy would not start on the shared data. Everything was put back.
failure.swap_stop_failed: Coolify's proxy would not stop. Everything was put back.
failure.swap_start_failed: Tugra's proxy could not take the ports. Everything was put back.
failure.give_back_failed: Giving back did not finish. Press it again.
failure.fallback_overdue: Coolify's certificate has been served for longer than a few minutes and no new certificate came. Check the domain's DNS and port 80, or give the server back.
failure.cert_check_unavailable: The server cannot check certificates (openssl is missing), so Coolify's certificate stays. Install openssl on the server, or give the server back.
failure.database_start_failed: A database would not start on its data under Tugra. Everything was put back.
failure.database_verify_failed: A database did not look the same after Tugra took it over. Everything was put back.
failure.service_not_ready: A service's containers did not come up ready under Tugra. If this shows after the switch, one container stopped or is not healthy. Give the server back, or check the service.
failure.service_verify_failed: A database inside a service did not look the same after Tugra took it over. Everything was put back.

error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.forbidden: Only a team owner can take a server over.
error.bad_confirmation: The name you typed is not the server's name.
error.takeover_server_busy: Another takeover or run holds this server.
error.takeover_no_apps: The import created no apps on this server.
error.takeover_unknown_item: An app chosen for rebuild is not in the import.
error.takeover_control_plane: This server runs Coolify itself. It is handled last, not in place.
error.takeover_proxy_absent: Coolify's proxy was not found on this server.
error.takeover_proxy_identity: The proxy on this server is not Coolify's. Nothing was touched.
error.takeover_proxy_unreadable: The server could not be read. Try again.
error.takeover_proxy_not_running: Coolify's proxy is not running, so there is nothing to hand over.
error.takeover_host_unreadable: The server could not be read. Try again.
error.takeover_rebuild_needs_side_by_side: An app that shares data with Coolify's copy cannot be rebuilt next to it.
error.takeover_test_failed: A domain failed its test. Fix it and test again.
error.takeover_item_not_ready: An app is not ready yet. Test again.
error.takeover_no_items: Nothing is left to take over.
error.takeover_not_swapped: The ports have not been handed over yet.
error.takeover_not_giveable: There is nothing to give back.
error.takeover_busy: Another step is running. Wait for it.
error.takeover_already_swapped: The ports are already Tugra's. Check again or give back.
error.takeover_plan_again: This takeover was given back. Plan a new one.
error.takeover_tugra_proxy_in_use: Tugra's proxy already runs on this server and serves other apps. Stop it or move those apps first.

swap.title: Take over the ports
swap.body: Coolify's proxy stops and Tugra's proxy takes ports 80 and 443. The sites keep their addresses. Apps that share data with Coolify are switched with a short break. You can give the server back with one click.

giveBack.title: Give back to Coolify
giveBack.body: Tugra's proxy and copies stop and Coolify's proxy and containers start again, as they were.
